input.description:
Shared evidence for every question: a text string, or user messages with text
parts.

items.description:
One part of a message. Image parts are accepted by the schema and refused with a
message naming the limitation, so a client learns why rather than seeing a parse error.
items.title: DecisionInputPart

content.description: A message's content: a string, or a list of parts.
content.title: DecisionMessageContent

oneOf.description: The optional `type` of an input message.
oneOf.title: DecisionMessageType

input.title: DecisionInput

model.description: The model that answers: the name of a model under `models` in the Spicepod.

oneOf.description: How likely a statement about the input is true. Answered with a `probability`.

Which of the supplied options fits the input. Answered with the most probable
option and the distribution over all of them.

items.description: One option of a choice question.

value.description:
A choice value. `OpenAI` treats a string and a boolean with the same text as
different values.
value.title: ChoiceValue

items.title: ChoiceOption

oneOf.description:
Where the input sits on ordered levels, lowest first. Answered with the
probability-weighted 0-based level index.

items.description: One level of a score question.
items.title: ScoreLevel

items.description: A question about the input, with an optional name echoed in its answer.
items.title: DecisionQuestion

questions.description: What to decide, in order: between 1 and 200 questions.

oneOf.description:
How much a chat model reasons before it answers. Omitted keeps the model's
setting. A Spice extension: `OpenAI`'s Decisions API has no such field, and a
decision model returns 400 for it.
oneOf.title: ReasoningEffort

safety_identifier.description:
Opaque end-user identifier, at most 128 characters. Forwarded to `OpenAI`
decision models.
